notes: Energized Barriers removes Paralyzing Shots from the Mage.
Greater Invisibility cancels Zul'jan's Boneslicer when the Mage is selected; line of sight Blood Sacrifice.
Spellsteal removes Spiny Shield from a Spineshield Beetle.
Greater Invisibility or Blink can break Bloodthorn Roots when the Mage is trapped.
Remove Curse dispels Insatiable Hunger from the Mage or an ally.
Greater Invisibility cancels Feast of Misery when the Mage is selected.
Remove Curse answers Curse of Doom on the Mage or an ally.
Greater Invisibility cancels selected Drain Life channels; use Dragon's Breath or Supernova for susceptible casts.
Greater Invisibility cancels Charonus's Void Cascade when the Mage is selected.
Polymorph the Protective Turtle to interrupt Shell Guard.
Spellsteal removes Accumulate Charge; Energized Barriers removes Slither Strike's snare.
Greater Invisibility cancels Gust or Arrow Barrage, Blink escapes A Knot of Snakes, and Ring of Frost supplies another Arrow Barrage stop.
Spellsteal eligible Magic buffs deliberately and Remove Curse answers Hex; Energized Barriers removes Frost Shock.
Greater Invisibility cancels selected casts and channels, while Ring of Frost controls susceptible raptor leaps; line of sight Serpentine Gust.
Spellsteal removes Blaze of Glory and Stormcloud Barrier.
Greater Invisibility cancels High Channeler Ryvati's Lightning Torrent when the Mage is selected.

recommendations: Use Counterspell, Spellsteal, and Dragon's Breath or Supernova after the cluster spawns to stop as many casts as possible.
Kill the Voidbound Emissary quickly and use Splitting Ice cleave when positioning permits.
Use Mage mobility to swing orbiting void orbs into allies and receive theirs.
Remove Curse clears the eligible effect from the Mage or an ally; Energized Barriers provides a self-only alternative through its snare component.

provenance.description: Original structured summary of Dorovon's Patch 12.1.0 Frost Mage dungeon utility and affix recommendations. Talent strings, gear, and performance rankings are intentionally excluded.
